Our people's dependence on alcohol is growing day by day, and a tense atmosphere is spreading across the country. Under these circumstances, it is crucial that we take action to uphold our noble social virtues, in the name of our nation's noble and devout character, to resist the onslaught of alcohol, and to bring this good practice to the lower strata of our society.\n\nAlcohol consumption in our country has been increasing steadily over the years. Although the soul may be saved from even the most desperate circumstances, we cannot ignore the serious consequences of long-term excessive consumption.

Police have received a tip that a smuggling ship loaded with contraband alcohol will dock at our port tonight.
